summary: Akzo Nobel N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, announcing the appointment of three non-executive directors (Stephan B. Tanda, Denise C. Johnson, Robert Schuchna) to the board of the combined company with Axalta Coating Systems Ltd., in connection with a pending merger of equals. The board will be chaired by Rakesh Sachdev (Axalta) with Ben Noteboom (AkzoNobel) as vice-chair. No financial terms, premium, or advisors are disclosed. The appointment is a step toward closing the merger; watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes.
